parameters.name: conn_id
parameters.description: The name of the connection to use.

parameters.name: cmd_path
parameters.description: Do not modify the parameter. It used to be the filepath to the pinot-admin.sh executable but in version 4.0.0 of apache-pinot provider, value of this parameter must remain the default value: `pinot-admin.sh`. It is left here to not accidentally override the `pinot_admin_system_exit` in case positional parameters were used to initialize the hook.

parameters.name: pinot_admin_system_exit
parameters.description: If true, the result is evaluated based on the status code. Otherwise, the result is evaluated as a failure if "Error" or "Exception" is in the output message.

parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: Optional DB schema that overrides the schema specified in the connection. Make sure that if you change the schema parameter value in the constructor of the derived Hook, such change should be done before calling the ``DBApiHook.__init__()``.

parameters.name: log_sql
parameters.description: Whether to log SQL query when it's executed. Defaults to *True*.
